# Source: Saint Benedict Presenting his Rule to Benedictine and Cistercian Monks in a Historiated Initial "O" from a Choirbook

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Saint Benedict Presenting his Rule to Benedictine and Cistercian Monks in a Historiated Initial "O" from a Choirbook
- **Artist / culture:** Italian (Siena) Martino di Bartolomeo (Italian, 1389-1434/5) 1394/95
- **Date:** 1394/95
- **Style:** medieval
- **Classification:** tempera
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 10927
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/10927
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/54f0b704-7108-5b91-1d0f-585758267fb4/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Medieval Manuscript

## Extracted source palette

`#282828, #C8C8B8, #785818, #586848, #B8A898, #987838, #989888, #B85828`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#151515`
- `surface`: `#303030`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#785818`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#C8C8B8`
- `surface_variant`: `#303030`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#555554`
- `error`: `#785818`

- Font: `cinzel` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.17:1`, surface `12.41:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.41:1`
- Control contrast: `6.16:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
